title: Level 6: The Eve machine and the server

tests.name: f03_test_module
tests.title: the standard module test, written in Eve: checks print one line, count, and summary raises when one failed

tests.name: f04_crypto
tests.title: the system module crypto: hashes, HMAC, codecs, random bytes (F-LIB-10)

tests.name: f05_os
tests.title: the system module os: run a program without a shell, read the environment (F-LIB-07)

tests.name: f06_json_text
tests.title: json.parse and json.text: JSON text in memory and plain values (F-LIB-05)

tests.name: f07_rpc
tests.title: the standard module rpc, in Eve: build JSON-RPC 2.0 lines (F-NET-08)

tests.name: f08_config
tests.title: the standard module config, in Eve: key = value files into a DataMap (F-TLS-12)

tests.name: f09_net
tests.title: the system module net: a server and a client as tasks of one script, lines over TCP (F-NET-02)

tests.name: f10_route_hello
tests.title: a server with routes and a client in one script: the modules net, http, route and service (F-NET-02, F-STR-08)

tests.name: f11_rpc_roundtrip
tests.title: JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP between a server and a client on localhost: rpc, http, route, service and net together (F-NET-08)

tests.name: f12_service_close
tests.title: a service with no count runs until its listener is closed; close wakes the pending accept (F-NET-02)

tests.name: f13_net_timeout
tests.title: set_timeout: a read that waits too long fails with $err_timeout and the server goes on (TD-27)

tests.name: f14_service_idle
tests.title: a client that sends nothing gets a 408 after the idle time and the next client is served (TD-29)

tests.name: f15_os_timeout
tests.title: os.run! with a time-out: the child is killed, status 124 (TD-9, TD-27)

tests.name: f16_os_env
tests.title: os.run! gives variables to the program it starts: a map String -> String is added to its environment (CMD-04, G-10)
